course.title: Industrial Management
course.department: Department of Materials Science and Engineering

content.value: Surge electric uses 4,000 toggle switches a year. Switches are priced as follows: 1 to 499,90 cents each; 500 to 999,85 cents each and 1,000 or more, 80 cents each. It costs approximately \$30 to prepare an order and receive it, and carrying costs are 40 percent of purchase price per unit on annual basis. Determine the optimal order quantity and total annual cost.

_source_title: B.Sc. Engineering 3rd Year 2nd Term Regular Examination, 2020
